phase_goal: Give each site an at-a-glance health summary at the top of its site view: latest readiness/coverage/status, run count and last-inspected date, open vs verified-fixed items from its fix plan, latest component warnings/failures, a coverage trend across runs, and the last clean run. Aggregated from runs and the fix plan already on disk; honest when a site has no runs.
reason_generation_started: Operator chose the per-site health summary next. Closes the GEN-021 known gap that site cards showed per-run status but no site-level health rollup (last-clean date, open findings count).
standing_directive: OPERATOR DIRECTIVE: do NOT trigger inspection runs and do NOT apply destructive cleanup. Aggregate from data already on disk; be honest when a site has no runs. Recorded as FND-GEN021-000.

functional: A site view shows a health summary: latest readiness, coverage, and overall status; run count and last-inspected timestamp; fix-plan open vs verified-fixed counts; latest warnings and failures; a coverage trend across runs; and the most recent clean run (no failed components) if any.
A site with no runs shows a clear 'not yet inspected' health state rather than fabricated metrics.
The summary is derived only from runs and the fix plan on disk (no run triggered).
usability: Interactive holistic walkthrough (as-a-user, no runs triggered): open a site with runs and see a coherent health summary; open a not-yet-inspected site and see the empty state; other views stay coherent.
Confirm no inspection is triggered by any navigation.
technical: validate:dashboard asserts the site-health API returns the aggregate fields (run_count, latest, fix_plan open/verified, coverage_trend) for a site with runs and an empty state for a site with none; validate:gen13 and validate stay green; git diff --check clean; no run-inspection process spawned.
